description: Part 9 probe P31 (lesson 09-04): SQL routines as the API boundary. Learns (a) whether PARAMETER STYLE GENERAL RPGLE scalar functions can RETURN CHAR(30) (JUCSRV getCustName), NUMERIC(5,0) (countCustOrders) and DECIMAL(7,0) (ZAISRV GET), with a qualified EXTERNAL NAME ('<lib>/JUCSRV(getCustName)') and an unqualified one resolved through the library list, under different routine names so both coexist; whether the exported-name case must match exactly (negative tests with GETCUSTNAME/get); whether RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT returns SQL NULL for a NULL argument; (b) the lesson script src/sql/09-04-routines.sql end to end (JUCHU_INQUIRY_JSON scalar function, LOW_STOCK SQL table function, LOW_STOCK_RS result-set procedure, JUCHU_REGISTER with JSON_TABLE NESTED PATH), run from the IFS with RUNSQLSTM after an iconv IBM-273->UTF-8 conversion; (c) both forms of JUCHU_INQUIRY_JSON (calling the registered GENERAL function vs joining TOKUIM); (d) what CHKOBJ / OBJECT_STATISTICS can see for LANGUAGE SQL routines (system object names and types, which is what TXCHECK v1 would test). SAFETY DESIGN: (1) the unqualified variants and the lesson objects point at &LIB-only copies JUCSRVU/ZAISRVU (CRTDUPOBJ into &LIB, deleted at the end), so an unqualified library-list resolution can never reach the private area; the qualified variants use the &LIB/ prefix explicitly. (2) every statement run outside the cl wrapper (db2 utility from sh steps) has all names qualified with &LIB. (3) RPG-backed functions are only called from the cl wrapper (library list = &LIB first, INQMSGRPY *DFT, no hang), never from db2/collect; the SQL-only routines are also exercised from the db2 job. (4) All CREATEs (sh steps, then the wrapper's own CREATEs) come before any call; DROPs are done afterwards in a new job (after sh). (5) The order-registration probe uses NEW order numbers J09901/J09902 built by JSON_OBJECT/JSON_ARRAY (no brackets in the CL source), pre-cleaned at the start, deleted at the end; JUCHUM/JUCHUD/ZAIKOM row counts are recorded before/after (VFY0904). Nothing is created or changed in the private area. Expected data (V2, unconfirmed): GET_CUST_NAME('C00001') = ACME TRADING CO padded to 30; COUNT_CUST_ORDERS('C00001') = 2; GET_STOCK_QTY('P00002') = 3 and 'P99999' = -1; LOW_STOCK returns P00002 (3<5) and P00005 (12<50) only; JUCHU_REGISTER duplicate call fails with SQLSTATE 75001.

steps.label: CRINQW

steps.label: CRINQJ

steps.label: CRREGC
steps.cmd: db2 "CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE &LIB.PRB_REGISTER_C (IN P_JSON VARCHAR(4000) CCSID 1208) LANGUAGE SQL SPECIFIC &LIB.PRBREGC MODIFIES SQL DATA SET OPTION COMMIT = *NONE BEGIN DECLARE V_NO CHAR(6); SET V_NO = (SELECT H.ORDER_NO FROM JSON_TABLE(P_JSON, 'lax \$' COLUMNS(ORDER_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.orderNo')) AS H); IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM &LIB.JUCHUM WHERE JUNO = V_NO) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '75001' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Order already exists'; END IF; INSERT INTO &LIB.JUCHUM (JUNO, JUTOK, JUDATE, JUTAN) SELECT H.ORDER_NO, H.CUSTOMER, H.ORDER_DATE, H.SALES_REP FROM JSON_TABLE(P_JSON, 'lax \$' COLUMNS(ORDER_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.orderNo', CUSTOMER CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.customer', ORDER_DATE DECIMAL(8, 0) PATH 'lax \$.orderDate', SALES_REP CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.salesRep')) AS H; INSERT INTO &LIB.JUCHUD (JUNO, JULINE, JUSHO, JUSU, JUTNK) SELECT T.ORDER_NO, T.LINE_NO, T.PRODUCT, T.QTY, T.PRICE FROM JSON_TABLE(P_JSON, 'lax \$' COLUMNS(ORDER_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.orderNo', NESTED PATH 'lax \$.lines[*]' COLUMNS(LINE_NO DECIMAL(3, 0) PATH 'lax \$.line', PRODUCT CHAR(6) PATH 'lax \$.product', QTY DECIMAL(5, 0) PATH 'lax \$.qty', PRICE DECIMAL(7, 2) PATH 'lax \$.unitPrice'))) AS T; END" 2>&1

SELECT ROUTINE_NAME, SPECIFIC_NAME, ROUTINE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA = '&LIB' ORDER BY ROUTINE_NAME
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJTYPE IN ('*PGM', '*SRVPGM', '*SQLUDT') ORDER BY OBJTYPE, OBJNAME
